title: Riot Squad Blck Edtn Ultra Peach Tea 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid - 2 Pack
description: This Pack Contains x2 50ml Shortfills Experience the epitome of refreshment with the delicious Riot Squad Black Edition E-Liquid Ultra Peach Tea 50ml Shortfill E-Liquid. This expertly crafted e juice blend combines the succulent sweetness of ripe peaches squeezed and stirred into a smooth and soothing sweet tea beverage served over crushed ice for added refreshment. Resulting in a delectable and satisfying vape that perfectly mimics the classic Peach Iced Tea beverage. This delectable Black Edition Shortfill is sure to become a staple in your Sub Ohm collection. So don’t wait, Add the Riot Squad Black Edition Ultra Peach Tea to your basket now to enjoy the great taste of sweet, juicy peaches and iced tea served over crushed ice. Riot Squad’s Black Edition e-liquids are the famous vape brand’s latest leap into bold new flavour territory. These moreish vape juices are available in both Shortfill and Nic Salt E-Liquids. So whatever your vaping style, you can be sure to enjoy the delicious flavours from the Riot Squad Black Edition collection. Why not treat your taste buds to the great taste of a Ultra Peach Tea Black Edition Nic Salt by Riot Squad 10ml. Making it ideal for Sub-Ohm Vape Kits. As it’s the perfect E Liquid ratio for large cloud creation that doesn’t lessen your vape juice flavour. Allowing you to enjoy your favourite Riot Squad flavours to the max. Using naturally derived vegetable glycerine and propylene glycol with pharmaceutical-grade nicotine. Riot Squad’s Vape Juices are renowned for their supreme quality and ability to deliver huge flavoursome vapour clouds. So if you are looking for delicious flavour and high-quality E-Liquids for your vapes, you can be confident the Riot Squad UK-based E-Liquid manufacturer will deliver premium, flavourful vapour clouds and explosively delicious flavours in every puff! If you love this delicious Riot Squad Shortfill 50ml, then check out their other equally moreish 10ml & 50ml E-Liquids. Designed to suit any vapers flavour requirements, you’re bound to find a Riot Squad Vape juice you’ll love. Go ahead treat your taste buds to an explosion of juicy fruit flavours, refreshing beverages, Confectionary/desserts, classic Mint/Menthol and tobacco flavours from Riot Squad's delicious Black Edition, Menthol, BAR EDTN and Punx E-Liquid ranges.
